title: DiBiPhil — Corpus of philosophical texts from Zeno's Digital Library
notes: Companion corpus of the DTA derived from Zeno.org's Digitale Bibliothek philosophical writings, DTABf/TEI-encoding, licence CC BY-SA 4.0 (repo live 200; presentation page https://www.deutschestextarchiv.de/dibiphil/ live 200). The 40 collected texts match, e.g. Böhme's 'Aurora oder Morgenröte im Aufgang' (1612) and Paracelsus treatises. Origin verbatim: 'DiBiPhil: Böhme, Aurora oder Morgenröte im Aufgang (1612)'. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: Deutsches Textarchiv (BBAW); source texts from Zeno.org's Digitale Bibliothek
